text: For centuries, sailors told stories about the kraken. It turned out to be real.
The giant squid can grow as long as a bus.
Its eyes are the size of dinner plates. The biggest in the animal kingdom.
It has three hearts. And its blood is blue.
Its brain is shaped like a doughnut, wrapped around its throat. So everything it eats goes through its brain.
And yet, nobody had ever seen one alive in the deep until 2004.
The first video of one in its home only came in 2012, off Japan.
Its great enemy is the sperm whale.
Whales have been found covered in sucker scars from their fights.
The kraken was never a myth. It was just hiding in the dark.
